description: Defines the QboneServerSession class and related helper class for managing a QUIC server session with QBONE protocol integration, including packet processing and control stream management.

classes.name: QboneCryptoServerStreamHelper
classes.description: Helper class for QuicCryptoServerStream to accept QBONE ALPN.

classes.name: QboneServerSession
classes.description: Manages a QBONE-enabled QUIC server session, handling packet processing, control stream creation, and encryption level management.

methods.name: CanAcceptClientHello
methods.description: Checks if the client hello message can be accepted based on QBONE ALPN.

methods.name: SetDefaultEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Overrides to set the default encryption level for the session.

methods.name: SendClientRequest
methods.description: Sends a client request through the session.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromNetwork
methods.description: Processes incoming packets from the network.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromPeer
methods.description: Processes incoming packets from the peer.

methods.name: SendPacketToClient
methods.description: Sends a packet to the client.

methods.name: SendPacketToNetwork
methods.description: Sends a packet to the network.

methods.name: CreateCryptoStream
methods.description: Creates a new crypto stream for the session.

methods.name: CreateControlStream
methods.description: Creates the control stream for QBONE.

methods.name: CreateControlStreamFromPendingStream
methods.description: Creates a control stream from a pending stream.
